title: Form Energy news row
description: A white band with an orange-ruled condensed uppercase title over a row of four tall pale-grey cards, each under a small orange mono tag (square top-left corner where the tag sits): a mono source line, a tight medium headline and a mono date pinned to the bottom. A centred, widely tracked mono 'read more' link below turns orange on hover. One card per row on phones.
notes: cards are fixed-height so dates line up; very long headlines need fewer words
